'''Milan K. Sanyal''' (born 6 January 1954) is an Indian [[physicist]], active in the fields of [[surface physics]], [[nanoscience]] and [[nanotechnology]].<ref name=":0">{{Cite web |last=Sciences (TWAS) |first=The World Academy of |title=Sanyal, Milan K. {{!}} TWAS |url=https://twas.org/directory/sanyal-milan-k |access-date=2025-04-24 |website=twas.org |language=en}}</ref> Prof.  Sanyal was the director of the [[Saha Institute of Nuclear Physics]]<ref>{{cite news|url=http://articles.timesofindia.indiatimes.com/2009-12-07/kolkata/28059670_1_platinum-jubilee-celebrations-insa-sinp|archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120826003205/http://articles.timesofindia.indiatimes.com/2009-12-07/kolkata/28059670_1_platinum-jubilee-celebrations-insa-sinp|url-status=dead|archive-date=August 26, 2012|title=Pratibha Patil to inaugurate science meet|date=December 7, 2009|work=[[The Times of India]]|accessdate=14 June 2011}}</ref> from 2009 to 2014 and is now Senior Professor in the institute.<ref name=":0" /> Recently he has been appointed co-chairman of the India-Japan Science Council.
